### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: the curated central bank companies in E&F's own
### 00_ef_companies.txt plus the one generated in zz_ef_cm_generic_banks.txt.
###
### FLAT `any_company` LISTS, NOT if/else_if CHAINS. A chain nests, and the
### previous version of this file had a 49-deep one inside an OR. Between that
### one, the 145-deep chain in the dispatcher and the 145-deep chain in the
### monopoly pass, a country that matched nothing walked far enough down to
### take the game with it:
###
###   Unhandled Exception C00000FD (EXCEPTION_STACK_OVERFLOW)
###
### Does this country hold any central bank company at all -- one of the
### 49 curated historical ones, or the generated one?

### Does this country hold the bank that WAS its central bank?
###
### No tag gate. The table of tag-to-company this used to test against
### disagreed with E&F -- E&F gives the Preussische Seehandlung to PRU, the
### table said NGF -- and every disagreement produced a country holding two
### central bank companies at once. Whoever E&F handed the bank to is who it
### belongs to.
zz_ef_cm_holds_own_historical_bank = {
	any_company = {
		OR = {
			is_company_type = company_type:company_BancoNacionArgentina
			is_company_type = company_type:company_BancoProvincia

### ...and the generated stand-in, which it should not still be holding once
### the real one has arrived.
zz_ef_cm_holds_stand_in_bank = {
	has_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_central_bank
}

### The central bank is a state building placed by E&F, not something anyone
### builds, so ownership of it is the only honest test for "has a central bank".
zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = {
	any_scope_state = {
		has_building = building_bank
	}
}
